changed_in.5.2: Code running under the protected call may suspend. A `coroutine.yield()` inside `f` reaches whoever resumed the coroutine and the protection survives the suspension; 5.1 raises rather than let a yield cross a protected call.
changed_in.5.5: An error object of `nil` is replaced by a string before it propagates, so the second value on the failing path is a string where earlier versions hand back `nil`.
